verdict_scope: Offline pure-renderer contract on actual frozen source; not database, engine, init-hook, filesystem-permission, or world acceptance

execution.toolchain: Existing pinned nix develop --offline; uv run --offline --frozen --no-sync

evidence.finding: Receiver copies identity and password using NAME_LENGTH; server connection acceptance requires successful auth, sex S, account_id below ARRAYLENGTH(ch_server), and an unused server slot. Account ID 1 meets the static role/index bound, not a demonstrated connection acceptance.
MAX_SERVERS is 5 and ch_server is declared with that extent; account_id 1 is an in-range role index.
NAME_LENGTH is 23 + 1, consistent with 23 ASCII payload bytes.
SQL SELECT and field mapping consume account_id, userid, user_pass, sex, email, group_id and state in the expected order.

Login columns permit unsigned account_id, userid varchar(23), user_pass varchar(32), sex including S, email varchar(39), group_id tinyint and unsigned state. Remaining columns have defaults or allow NULL.

verified_contract: Exactly five bytes-valued files, ordered main, logs, web, roulette, interserver; each begins with USE of the validated quoted selected database.

Exact builtin str required. All three fields accept length 23 and reject length 24 before derivation; empty strings, injection text, NUL, non-ASCII, booleans, integer zero and str subtypes are rejected before derivation.
Database and identity reject each punctuation character permitted for passwords. Allowed password punctuation roundtrips through X-prefixed hex literal bytes without a SQL string-escaping step.
Pinned main body equals the original public bytes with only the established 29900:30138 suppression span removed. Logs, web and roulette equal original public bytes after removal of the USE prefix.
Independent static table-name extraction finds 70 distinct tables in the same selected database. This is not a SQL parser result.

Exactly one final plain login INSERT: account_id 1, sex S, empty email, group_id 0 and state 0; credential fields use hex string literals. No IGNORE, REPLACE, upsert, migration, UPDATE, DELETE or CREATE DATABASE operation was introduced.
ValueError, RuntimeError, KeyboardInterrupt and SystemExit raised by derivation preserve the same exception object and originating frame.

existing_private_configs_source_only.finding: private_configs routes login_server, ipban_db, char_server, map_server, log_db and web_server database suffixes to the same data[db_name]. This matches the renderer single-database routing.

limitations: Actual MariaDB parsing, executed row readback, fresh-database init-hook ordering and execution remain pending; no database acceptance is inferred from regex/byte checks.
Mount integration, container UID ownership and private SQL file permissions remain pending. The pure renderer returns bytes and cannot establish correct file modes.
Hex literals encode plaintext sensitive credentials; they neither encrypt nor redact them.
Not a migration, reset, existing-world repair, launch authority, or world-initialization result.
Compose/native integration and combined project gates are outside this independent review.
